ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% low-intensity (dark grey/black) to 35% high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels across the visible ventral surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe (image left) features a high-intensity contiguous patch on the outer distal margin with interior speckling. Right lobe (image right) exhibits extensive, high-contrast white striations and mottling originating from the tip and extending across approximately 50% of the lobe's surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated aperture of approximately 72 degrees and a depth-to-height ratio of roughly 0.15.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular trailing boundary with high-frequency micro-serrations and several larger macro-indentations; right lobe distal edge shows higher amplitude pixel-shifts (15-20 pixels) compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, sweeping upward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of localized, circular, high-contrast pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) on the terminal distal tips of both lobes; left tip shows a cluster of ~8 units, right tip shows ~6 units.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, thin, low-width white linear disruptions (rake marks) visible on the medial dark region of the right lobe, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Ectoparasitic calcified clusters (barnacles) present on the distal tips; minor structural irregularities/chipping along the trailing edge of the right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetrical pigmentation mapping; the right lobe contains a significantly higher density of white pixel clusters compared to the predominantly dark left lobe.
